§6CMB Steel & Nitanium

§aEndgame alloys for the DFC, Spark Capacitor, and elite radiation shielding.

§6CMB Steel (Combine Steel)§f:
Late-game superalloy. Crucible: §e6 Magnetized Tungsten Nuggets§f + §e3 Poisonous Mud Nuggets§f → 1 ingot. Poisonous mud comes from the §bWatz Power Plant§f, so you cannot skip it. Also from smelting CMB scrap dropped by the Hunter Chopper.
Uses: §bCMB-Schrabidate Laser Crystal§f (UV FEL range), §bSpark Capacitor§f, DFC fuel injector, Hunter Chopper, CMB Steel Tiles (§e3,000§f blast resist) and Reinforced CMB Bricks (§e30,000§f blast resist).

§6Nitanium§f:
Purple powdery blend, no refined form. Craft from 6 cyclotron-produced powders: Neptunium + Iodine + Thorium + Astatine + Neodymium + Caesium. Also from trixite crystals or asteroid mining.
Uses: §bElite Radiation Absorber§f (Saturnite + Nitanium + Advanced Absorber), §bNITAN 100 Octane Super Fuel§f.

§ePS:§f CMB Steel requires poisonous mud from the Watz, so plan accordingly. Nitanium is optional until you need elite radiation protection.
